chunks: They set aside a portion of the food We have given them for those they do not know. By God, you will surely have to answer for all you contrive!
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people assign shares to what they do not know?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the pre-Islamic and polytheistic practice of allocating portions of wealth to idols or fabricated deities, emphasizing that such acts stem from ignorance rather than divine command. It serves as a profound reminder of individual accountability, where believers will be questioned specifically about the 'fabrications' (iftira') they invented for God, linking ritual practice to theological accuracy. This highlights the Shia emphasis on distinguishing between authentic revelation and human innovation in worship.
